screenSummary.playArea: A road and a position-time graph with a checkpoint secant and a moving tangent.
screenSummary.controlArea: Use playback, drag on the graph, or use the time slider’s arrow keys.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Drive between the checkpoints. Find when the tangent and secant have the same slope.

screenSummary.playArea: Position-time graphs of a smooth drive and one with a corner.
screenSummary.controlArea: Use playback, drag on the graph, or use the time slider’s arrow keys.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Compare a smooth trip with one whose speed changes abruptly at 5 s.

lesson.moveCarHelp: Use Left and Right or A and D to move the car. Hold Shift for smaller steps.
lesson.oneSided: Left speed 5 m/s · Right speed 15 m/s
lesson.close: Within 0.1 m/s at the marked time.
lesson.all: Every interior time is a match.
lesson.which: Which condition fails at the corner?
lesson.continuousAnswer: On the corner route, both sides of the position graph meet at 5 s.
lesson.differentAnswer: On the corner route, position is continuous. The one-sided slopes differ at 5 s.
lesson.challengePrompt: Mark a time when the speed equals the average speed.
lesson.near: A match lies within half a time step of the mark.
